meanings.en: the storage of goods in a warehouse
meanings.exampleEn: The company spends a lot on warehousing during the holiday season.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket tatil sezonunda depolamaya çok para harcar.

meanings.en: in a strange or unusual way
meanings.exampleEn: She was oddly quiet during the entire meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantı boyunca tuhaf bir şekilde sessizdi.

meanings.en: relating to careful plans to achieve an aim
meanings.exampleEn: The general made a tactical decision to retreat.
meanings.exampleTr: General geri çekilmek için taktiksel bir karar verdi.

meanings.en: decided or arranged in advance
meanings.exampleEn: The planned trip had to be postponed because of the storm.
meanings.exampleTr: Planlanan gezi fırtına yüzünden ertelenmek zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: a small stream
meanings.exampleEn: A clear brook ran through the meadow behind the house.
meanings.exampleTr: Evin arkasındaki çayırdan berrak bir dere akıyordu.

meanings.en: to strengthen a place against attack
meanings.exampleEn: They fortified the town with thick stone walls.
meanings.exampleTr: Kasabayı kalın taş duvarlarla tahkim ettiler.

meanings.en: affected by something unpleasant such as illness
meanings.exampleEn: Many people in the region were afflicted with a rare disease.
meanings.exampleTr: Bölgedeki birçok insan nadir bir hastalığa yakalanmıştı.

meanings.en: influenced or acted upon by something
meanings.exampleEn: The areas affected by the flood received emergency aid.
meanings.exampleTr: Selden etkilenen bölgeler acil yardım aldı.

meanings.en: refusing to change one's opinion or behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: He was too obstinate to admit that he was wrong.
meanings.exampleTr: Yanıldığını kabul edemeyecek kadar inatçıydı.

meanings.en: determined to do things one's own way
meanings.exampleEn: The headstrong girl ignored all her parents' advice.
meanings.exampleTr: Dik başlı kız, ailesinin tüm öğütlerini görmezden geldi.

meanings.en: willing to obey or agree with others
meanings.exampleEn: The new employee was quiet and compliant with every rule.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni çalışan sessiz ve her kurala uyumluydu.

meanings.en: unable to escape from a place or situation
meanings.exampleEn: The miners were trapped underground for two days.
meanings.exampleTr: Madenciler iki gün boyunca yer altında mahsur kaldı.

meanings.en: stuck and unable to move
meanings.exampleEn: The door was jammed and we could not open it.
meanings.exampleTr: Kapı sıkışmıştı ve onu açamadık.

meanings.en: a workshop or studio of an artist or designer
meanings.exampleEn: The fashion designer welcomed clients into her elegant atelier.
meanings.exampleTr: Moda tasarımcısı müşterilerini şık atölyesinde ağırladı.

meanings.en: completely full of people or things
meanings.exampleEn: The small room was crammed with old furniture.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük oda eski mobilyalarla tıka basa doluydu.

meanings.en: unfashionable and dull in appearance
meanings.exampleEn: She felt dowdy next to her stylish colleagues.
meanings.exampleTr: Şık iş arkadaşlarının yanında kendini eski moda hissetti.

meanings.en: affecting the mind without being consciously noticed
meanings.exampleEn: The advertisement contained subliminal messages about happiness.
meanings.exampleTr: Reklam, mutlulukla ilgili bilinçaltına yönelik mesajlar içeriyordu.

meanings.en: a substitute, especially in sports
meanings.exampleEn: The coach sent a sub onto the field in the final minutes.
meanings.exampleTr: Antrenör son dakikalarda sahaya bir yedek oyuncu gönderdi.

meanings.en: a German submarine, especially in the world wars
meanings.exampleEn: The convoy was attacked by a German U-boat in the Atlantic.
meanings.exampleTr: Konvoy Atlantik'te bir Alman denizaltısı tarafından saldırıya uğradı.

meanings.en: the act of destroying oneself
meanings.exampleEn: His reckless habits led him toward self-destruction.
meanings.exampleTr: Pervasız alışkanlıkları onu öz yıkıma sürükledi.

meanings.en: the time when light first appears in the morning
meanings.exampleEn: The fishermen set out at daybreak.
meanings.exampleTr: Balıkçılar şafak vakti yola çıktı.

meanings.en: the time before night when daylight is fading
meanings.exampleEn: We walked home just as dusk began to fall.
meanings.exampleTr: Alacakaranlık çökmeye başlarken eve doğru yürüdük.

meanings.en: the time when it begins to get dark
meanings.exampleEn: They reached the village just before nightfall.
meanings.exampleTr: Köye tam gece olmadan ulaştılar.

meanings.en: the traditional stories and customs of a community
meanings.exampleEn: Many of these tales are part of local folklore.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu hikâyelerin çoğu yerel folklorun bir parçasıdır.

meanings.en: according to what is claimed but not proven
meanings.exampleEn: He allegedly stole money from the company.
meanings.exampleTr: İddiaya göre şirketten para çalmış.

meanings.en: according to what people say or report
meanings.exampleEn: The actor is reportedly moving to another country.
meanings.exampleTr: Söylendiğine göre oyuncu başka bir ülkeye taşınıyor.

meanings.en: in a way that shows uncertainty or doubt
meanings.exampleEn: She looked at the map doubtfully before turning left.
meanings.exampleTr: Sola dönmeden önce haritaya kuşkuyla baktı.

meanings.en: the outer surface or appearance of something
meanings.exampleEn: The exterior of the building was painted bright white.
meanings.exampleTr: Binanın dış cephesi parlak beyaza boyanmıştı.

meanings.en: in a way that was expected
meanings.exampleEn: Predictably, the train was late again this morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Tahmin edilebileceği gibi, tren bu sabah yine gecikti.

meanings.en: to form a circle around something
meanings.exampleEn: Tall trees encircle the quiet little lake.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun ağaçlar sessiz küçük gölü çevreliyor.

meanings.en: next to or near something
meanings.exampleEn: Our office is in the building adjacent to the bank.
meanings.exampleTr: Ofisimiz bankanın bitişiğindeki binadadır.

meanings.en: a person responsible for a crime or problem
meanings.exampleEn: The police soon found the culprit behind the theft.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis kısa sürede hırsızlığın arkasındaki suçluyu buldu.

meanings.en: a lack of trust in someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: There was deep mistrust between the two neighbours.
meanings.exampleTr: İki komşu arasında derin bir güvensizlik vardı.

meanings.en: a large group of people or animals
meanings.exampleEn: A horde of tourists filled the narrow streets.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir turist kalabalığı dar sokakları doldurdu.

meanings.en: a rounded swelling on a surface
meanings.exampleEn: There was a strange bulge in his jacket pocket.
meanings.exampleTr: Ceket cebinde tuhaf bir şişkinlik vardı.

meanings.en: swollen or soft and rounded
meanings.exampleEn: Her eyes were puffy after a night of crying.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir gece ağladıktan sonra gözleri şişmişti.

meanings.en: red, swollen and sore, usually from infection
meanings.exampleEn: The doctor said his throat was badly inflamed.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktor boğazının ciddi şekilde iltihaplandığını söyledi.

meanings.en: done in a careful and orderly way
meanings.exampleEn: She is methodical and checks every detail twice.
meanings.exampleTr: O metodiktir ve her ayrıntıyı iki kez kontrol eder.

meanings.en: done without a plan or pattern
meanings.exampleEn: The winners were chosen in a random draw.
meanings.exampleTr: Kazananlar rastgele bir çekilişle seçildi.

meanings.en: food bought to be eaten away from the place it was made
meanings.exampleEn: We ordered Chinese takeout for dinner.
meanings.exampleTr: Akşam yemeği için Çin paket servis yemeği söyledik.

meanings.en: the moment a rocket leaves the ground
meanings.exampleEn: The crowd cheered at the rocket's liftoff.
meanings.exampleTr: Kalabalık roketin kalkışında tezahürat yaptı.

meanings.en: fond of talking in a friendly way
meanings.exampleEn: The taxi driver was very chatty during the ride.
meanings.exampleTr: Taksi şoförü yolculuk boyunca çok konuşkandı.

meanings.en: talking a lot, especially about unimportant things
meanings.exampleEn: The garrulous old man told the same stories every day.
meanings.exampleTr: Geveze yaşlı adam her gün aynı hikâyeleri anlattı.

meanings.en: slow to show feelings or opinions; kept for someone
meanings.exampleEn: He is a reserved man who rarely shares his feelings.
meanings.exampleTr: O, duygularını nadiren paylaşan çekingen bir adamdır.

meanings.en: a large natural or artificial lake used for water supply
meanings.exampleEn: The city's water comes from a reservoir in the hills.
meanings.exampleTr: Şehrin suyu tepelerdeki bir su haznesinden gelir.

meanings.en: the taste of a particular food or drink
meanings.exampleEn: This ice cream has a rich chocolate flavour.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu dondurmanın yoğun bir çikolata aroması var.

meanings.en: to enjoy food or an experience slowly and fully
meanings.exampleEn: She closed her eyes to savour the first sip of coffee.
meanings.exampleTr: İlk kahve yudumunun tadını çıkarmak için gözlerini kapattı.

meanings.en: having no taste
meanings.exampleEn: The soup was watery and almost flavourless.
meanings.exampleTr: Çorba sulu ve neredeyse tatsızdı.

meanings.en: having a strong and pleasant taste
meanings.exampleEn: The stew was rich and flavourful after hours of cooking.
meanings.exampleTr: Yahni saatlerce piştikten sonra zengin ve lezzetliydi.

meanings.en: a person who likes telling jokes or playing tricks
meanings.exampleEn: He is the joker of the group and always makes us laugh.
meanings.exampleTr: O grubun şakacısıdır ve bizi her zaman güldürür.

meanings.en: a short advertisement meant to create interest
meanings.exampleEn: The studio released a teaser for the new film.
meanings.exampleTr: Stüdyo yeni film için merak uyandıran bir tanıtım yayınladı.

meanings.en: the systems used for sending and receiving information
meanings.exampleEn: The storm cut off all communications with the island.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtına adayla tüm iletişimi kesti.

meanings.en: arranged for now but likely to be changed later
meanings.exampleEn: They reached a provisional agreement before the final talks.
meanings.exampleTr: Son görüşmelerden önce geçici bir anlaşmaya vardılar.

meanings.en: to attract someone, often by a trick
meanings.exampleEn: They used cheap prices to lure customers into the shop.
meanings.exampleTr: Müşterileri dükkâna çekmek için ucuz fiyatlar kullandılar.

meanings.en: a tendency or desire to do something
meanings.exampleEn: She had no inclination to argue with him.
meanings.exampleTr: Onunla tartışmaya hiç niyeti yoktu.

meanings.en: a natural tendency to behave in a certain way
meanings.exampleEn: He has a propensity for spending money too quickly.
meanings.exampleTr: Parayı çok çabuk harcamaya eğilimi var.

meanings.en: a large tent used for outdoor events
meanings.exampleEn: The wedding reception was held in a huge white marquee.
meanings.exampleTr: Düğün resepsiyonu büyük beyaz bir çadırda yapıldı.

meanings.en: very or extremely
meanings.exampleEn: It was awfully kind of you to help me.
meanings.exampleTr: Bana yardım etmen son derece nazikti.

meanings.en: the act of taking something that is not yours
meanings.exampleEn: He was caught stealing apples from the market.
meanings.exampleTr: Pazardan elma çalarken yakalandı.

meanings.en: an idea suggested as an explanation to be tested
meanings.exampleEn: The scientists tested their hypothesis with several experiments.
meanings.exampleTr: Bilim insanları hipotezlerini birkaç deneyle test etti.

meanings.en: a person or thing that is a threat or danger
meanings.exampleEn: Speeding drivers are a menace to pedestrians.
meanings.exampleTr: Aşırı hızlı sürücüler yayalar için bir tehdittir.

meanings.en: suggesting the presence of danger or threat
meanings.exampleEn: A menacing dog growled at the gate.
meanings.exampleTr: Tehditkâr bir köpek kapıda hırladı.

meanings.en: making someone feel frightened or nervous
meanings.exampleEn: Speaking in front of a large crowd can be intimidating.
meanings.exampleTr: Büyük bir kalabalığın önünde konuşmak göz korkutucu olabilir.

meanings.en: a tale that keeps the reader anxious about what happens next
meanings.exampleEn: She wrote a suspense story full of unexpected twists.
meanings.exampleTr: Beklenmedik dönüşlerle dolu bir gerilim öyküsü yazdı.

meanings.en: during the whole period or in every part
meanings.exampleEn: She remained calm throughout the difficult interview.
meanings.exampleTr: Zorlu mülakat boyunca sakin kaldı.

meanings.en: extremely loud
meanings.exampleEn: The deafening noise of the jets filled the sky.
meanings.exampleTr: Jetlerin sağır edici gürültüsü gökyüzünü kapladı.

meanings.en: very loud and deep; growing very fast
meanings.exampleEn: He answered in a booming voice that filled the hall.
meanings.exampleTr: Salonu dolduran gümbürtülü bir sesle cevap verdi.

meanings.en: for this reason; therefore
meanings.exampleEn: The roads were icy, hence the many accidents.
meanings.exampleTr: Yollar buzluydu, bu nedenle birçok kaza oldu.

meanings.en: a mark used to show something is correct or done
meanings.exampleEn: Put a checkmark next to each completed task.
meanings.exampleTr: Tamamlanan her görevin yanına bir onay işareti koy.

meanings.en: to make something less tight or firm
meanings.exampleEn: He loosened his tie after the long meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun toplantıdan sonra kravatını gevşetti.
